summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour continues his detailed description of the Prophet's prayer (salah), focusing on the ruku (bowing) position. He explains the proper physical form during ruku, including hand and arm placement, back positioning, and body alignment. Sh. Ali Mashhour emphasizes the Islamic principle of tranquility (ina) in prayer, which requires the body to come to complete stillness in each position for a minimum duration (approximately the time to say Subhan three times). He discusses the various remembrances and supplications the Prophet would recite during ruku, while clarifying that Quranic recitation is specifically prohibited in both ruku and sujud (prostration), except when making supplication using Quranic verses.
